purpose: Repeatable deterministic regression scenarios for Auctaryn agent-security controls. This is not certification or proof of universal mediation.

taxonomy.atlas_mapping_level: tactic-level; validate specific technique IDs separately

scenarios.name: Agent Goal Hijack
scenarios.expected: Conflicting override directive is detected by the context-integrity control.

scenarios.name: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
scenarios.expected: Unrecognized tool/action remains pending and never auto-approved.

scenarios.name: Identity and Privilege Abuse
scenarios.expected: A scoped token cannot invoke a capability absent from its grant.

scenarios.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
scenarios.expected: Mutation of signed permissions invalidates publisher-signature verification.

scenarios.name: Unexpected Code Execution
scenarios.expected: Runtime adapter refuses a free-form shell command string instead of a bounded argv array.

scenarios.name: Memory and Context Poisoning
scenarios.expected: Known instruction-override poisoning is detected and stored memory is explicitly quarantined.

scenarios.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
scenarios.expected: HMAC verification rejects a message whose payload was changed after signing.

scenarios.name: Cascading Failures
scenarios.expected: An agent with a tripped circuit breaker is blocked.

scenarios.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
scenarios.expected: The local step-up contract rejects replay; actual IdP MFA integration remains an explicit production gap.

scenarios.name: Rogue Agents
scenarios.expected: Persistent global emergency stop refuses execution checks.
